newsitem.title: UK: UK shares drop, nervous ahead of U.S. jobs report.
newsitem.headline: UK shares drop, nervous ahead of U.S. jobs report.

text.p: UK stocks opened lower on Friday after the latest bout of Wall Street jitters that the U.S. economy may be expanding fast enough to prompt a rise in interest rates.

Dealers said they expected the market to trade nervously ahead of today's key U.S. jobs report for August, and by 0748 GMT, the FTSE 100 was down 16.2 points at 3,871.0 - backtracking on two days of gains. Decliners were in a four-to-one majority.

The Dow and T-bonds dropped yesterday, after strong weekly jobless claims numbers, yet dealers said the UK market's losses would be limited by renewed bid speculation, coupled with the recent build-up of cash in investment funds.
